title: HELP! Trying to come up with summon system by making a summon a weapon and tieing skills to them.

posts.author: AgataSain
posts.body:
Hello.
I was trying to set up a "Pokémon" like of gameplay of summoning lil card demons when a character has card equiped as weapon, head, body or Shield. ( It's just for engine to be able to equip them all together, in world it works when you have a card like a pokeball).
1)So I tried to tie weapon "Ace of spades" to giving a type of attack summon. It appears during a battle but the skills don't appear no matter what I do. If anyone knows what to do, i would be grearfull
2) I also would want to know how an equipment can learn new skills depending on gained AP. And how it can be shown in the menus so the players could see what skills are learned by the equipment.
(I tried
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/ap-system.125658/
plugin but it still didn't let me see the learned skills)

skills only show up there if they match the skill type and they are either learned, or are granted by traits on the actor's equipment, states, and so on. did you give the card traits to grant specific summon skills? you havent shown a screenshot of the card in the database.

2) I also would want to know how an equipment can learn new skills depending on gained AP. And how it can be shown in the menus so the players could see what skills are learned by the equipment.
(I tried
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/ap-system.125658/
plugin but it still didn't let me see the learned skills)

its as i said for the cards. you gave it a trait for the summon skill type, but you still need to teach the actor skills with the summon skill type either via their class learning it at some level or by their equipment having traits to add them. if the actor doesnt have any summon skills, they cant show up in the list.
also when sharing images from your project - please take screenshots instead of pictures from another device, and change the language used in the editor to English to that others can read how everything is set up.

not sure what good sending the entire project would do. as shown in the screenshots, all i did was install both plugins (ap system above the equipment learn system as specified by the latter), gave an <ap: x> notetag to some skills, and then gave a weapon a notetag to learn those skills.
ill attach the plugins .js file (it only has the 2 plugins listed. you still need to have your versions of the plugins inside the plugins folder) and the weapons and skills json files, but theyre not going to show anything that wasnt shown in the screenshots or described above
AgataSain said:
It seems that some of mine are conflicting with it and I want to find out which one.
Click to expand...
if you believe theres a plugin incompatibility, then its better to start by disabling all plugins, enabling the ones required for the skill learning system, testing those together to make sure it works, then you start re-enabling plugins and testing to see where's the first point that failure happens.
its also worth mentioning that some issues may be because of load order. when i tested the plugins with visustella, i had put Fomar's plugins all below all the visustella ones

posts.author: AgataSain
posts.body:
My last question. (I'm sorry)
Is there a code or variable to make that the weapon already had a skill or got api point without a battle with those plugins or it's possible to give a weapon a skill without plugins

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
AgataSain said:
Is there a code or variable to make that the weapon already had a skill... without plugins
Click to expand...
yes. as i said before, you add the skill to the weapon before via its traits. not just the skill type
or, you teach the actor's class the skills, dont give them the skill type to use them, and you give the weapon the skill type trait to make them visible when equipped. although this wouldnt be ideal if all items were meant to give different "summon" skills as each weapon would give the same pool of skills or would need you to make multiple "summon" skill types and have each skill belong to the right one
AgataSain said:
Is there a code or variable to make that the weapon already had a skill or got api point without a battle with those plugins
Click to expand...
the FAQ for the ap system plugin says theres a gainAp() function on actors that can be used to make them gain Ap, so you can probably use script commands using it to increase a character's AP towards any skill they have gear on that teaches it to them
